0:
sources:
  service:
    enabled: true
    namespace: ""
    annotationFilter: ""
    serviceTypeFilter:
      - LoadBalancer
    publishInternal: false
    publishHostIP: false
  ingress:
    enabled: false
  dnsEndpoint:
    enabled: false
  istioGateway:
    enabled: false
  istioVirtualService:
    enabled: false
  gatewayHTTPRoute:
    enabled: true
    namespace: ""
  gatewayGRPCRoute:
    enabled: true
    namespace: ""
  gatewayTLSRoute:
    enabled: true
  gatewayTCPRoute:
    enabled: true
  gatewayUDPRoute:
    enabled: true
  priority:
    - gateway-httproute
    - gateway-grpcroute
    - service
groupMapping:
  defaultGroup: "Services"
reconciliation:
  interval: 5m
  retryOnError: 30s
  disableDNSCheck: false
auth:
  apiKey:
    enabled: false
  jwt:
    enabled: false
